title: Painting a Rainbow
description: Three short recordings about painting pictures and colours.
instructions: Read the questions first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Art class
parts.intro: You will hear Miss Lan and Tom in art class.

script.speaker: Miss Lan
script.text: Tom, what are you painting?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: I am painting a rainbow.

script.speaker: Miss Lan
script.text: Wow! How many colours are in your rainbow?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Seven! Red, orange, yellow, green, blue and more.

script.speaker: Miss Lan
script.text: It is beautiful, Tom!

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: I use a big brush. It is fun to paint.

script.speaker: Miss Lan
script.text: Good work. Put your picture on the wall when it is dry.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Rainbows come after the rain. I love them very much.

parts.title: Part 2 · My picture
parts.intro: You will hear Mai talking about her picture.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I paint a big yellow sun over the rainbow.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I paint a little house with a green door.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I do not paint a cat. I paint a dog.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: My picture is not finished yet.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Tomorrow, I want to paint some flowers.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I want to show it to my mum and dad tonight.

parts.title: Part 3 · Mixing colours
parts.intro: You will hear Tom and Mai mixing paint.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: I have blue paint and yellow paint.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Mix them. What colour do you get?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Green! I like green.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Now I want purple. I mix red and blue.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Oh no! The paint is on my shirt!

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Do not worry, Tom. We can wash your shirt.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: OK. I am sorry. I will be more careful.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Let us paint one more picture together. It will be fun.

questions.explanation: Tom says he is painting a rainbow.
